bull.t: Sustained revenue growth and raised guidance
bull.b: The repeated beat-and-raise record and 44% quarterly growth indicate durable demand for Zeta’s platform rather than a single-period increase. Raised revenue guidance also supports continued execution, customer expansion, and stronger operating scale over the next several quarters.

Rapidly growing free cash flow provides internally generated funding for product investment, acquisitions, and other capital allocation priorities. Strong cash conversion despite near break-even GAAP earnings suggests the platform can scale with relatively disciplined capital needs.

bull.t: AI adoption and proprietary data strengthen the platform
bull.b: Zeta’s proprietary data footprint, identity capabilities, and AI integrations can deepen customer dependence on its platform and improve campaign outcomes. Higher retention among AI adopters supports expansion within accounts, while major partnerships broaden distribution and product relevance.

bear.b: Although losses have narrowed and adjusted metrics are improving, inconsistent GAAP profitability leaves earnings power sensitive to operating costs and execution. Until scale converts into durable bottom-line income, the company has less evidence of fully established profitability.

A higher-cost channel mix can limit margin expansion even while revenue grows, particularly if agency-led social activity becomes a larger part of the business. Persistent mix pressure would constrain operating leverage and reduce the cash retained from incremental sales.

bear.t: Headline growth includes meaningful M&A contribution
bear.b: The gap between reported and ex-M&A growth shows that acquisitions contribute materially to the headline trajectory. Sustaining the overall pace therefore depends more heavily on continued organic execution and the company’s ability to translate acquired scale into lasting growth.
